text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm spending the evening planning out Special Week's training, when…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hello? Ah, Trainer! I knew you'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I stopped by your room to give you some of the carrots my mom just sent me, but you weren't there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So I thought you might still be working… and here you are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week takes a look at what I'm doing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Oh, that's my training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're working so late into the night just for my sake?
choice_data_list: It's because I want to help you win.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You always do so much for me… You're way too kind…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, is there anything else I can do? What if I go for a run along the riverbank?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna do anything I can to win! Just sitting around isn't gonna cut it!
choice_data_list: Well then, how about some extra training?!
You should rest up and prepare for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna do anything I can to win! Just sitting around isn't gonna cut it!
choice_data_list: Well then, how about some extra training?!
Well then, how about some extra training?!
You should rest up and prepare for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! All righty! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Have you got a new training regimen ready for me?! I'm excited to see what's in store!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Oh, wait. I'm still in my uniform, haha! Let me go get changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening, Special Week runs as much as her body allows, as if she's letting out all of her emotions on the track.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? You don't want me to do anything? But I can't get ready for tomorrow if…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, now I see! We're gonna start the new training regimen that you're working on now, tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Roger that! I'll head back to the dorm and get to sleep right away then!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sock it to me with all you've got tomorrow! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Whoops. I almost forgot! Good night, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, when training begins…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Let's get right to it!
choice_data_list: Why do you have your signature racewear on?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just really motivated right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Take a good look, Trainer. This is the Umamusume you're in charge of.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I came to this academy all the way from Hokkaido, and I've grown to become the capable racer that I am today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ever since I met you, I've been able to run like this…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So, I wanna show my thanks by becoming the top Umamusume in all of Japan!
choice_data_list: I'll keep supporting you until your dream comes true.
I'll keep supporting you until your dream comes true.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please and thank you! All righty, time to crush another training session!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week, flashy as ever, is cheered on by the other Umamusume as she starts to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's almost like they've already acknowledged her as the top Umamusume in all of Japan.
